description: Source code for the NTLM HTTP authentication mechanism implementation in Chromium, including functions for generating authentication tokens, handling challenge parsing, and managing dependencies and configurations.

classes.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism
classes.description: Implements NTLM authentication mechanism for HTTP, managing challenge parsing, token generation, and configuration.

classes.name: ScopedProcSetter
classes.description: Helper class to temporarily override static function pointers for time, randomness, and hostname retrieval.

methods.name: GetMSTime
methods.description: Returns current time in microseconds multiplied by 10.

methods.name: GenerateRandom
methods.description: Fills a buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: SetAuthTokenFromBinaryToken
methods.description: Encodes a binary token in base64 and prepends 'NTLM ' to form an auth token string.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::HttpAuthNtlmMechanism
methods.description: Constructor initializing NTLM client features based on preferences.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::Init
methods.description: Initialization method, currently always returns true.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Determines if identity is needed based on whether challenge token is empty.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates that explicit credentials are allowed.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::ParseChallenge
methods.description: Parses NTLM challenge tokens from server.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an NTLM authentication token based on credentials and challenge.

methods.name: HttpAuthNtlmMechanism::SetDelegation
methods.description: Stub for setting delegation; currently does nothing.
